title: The Insane Story Behind the Ferrari Enzo
description:
A car named after a dead man, sold only to people Ferrari chose, with a final example given to a Pope. That is the short version of the Ferrari Enzo. The long version is stranger: a road car built with Formula One technology that Formula One itself would not allow, whose numbers every source reports differently. This is the story behind the Ferrari Enzo, and where the tellers disagree. Our sources are Wikipedia's pages on the Enzo and the F50, RM Sotheby's catalogue pages for four different cars, Sports Car Market, Hagerty, the magazine evo, Jalopnik, the DuPont Registry and Italpassion. Where they conflict, we show both versions. Our own arithmetic is labelled, and what we could not find is flagged.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
